name: Till Death Do Us Part
tagline: A Tuscan wedding, a vintage to die for, and a toast nobody will forget.
description: Sun-drenched vines, a feuding wine dynasty, and a wedding that half the guests want stopped. When the father of the bride drops dead after the toast, the family's bitter secrets pour out.
artStyle: Golden-hour Italian countryside, watercolour and ink, rich wine reds

cocktails.name: Tuscan Spritz
cocktails.recipe: Prosecco, Aperol and soda with an orange slice.
cocktails.mocktail: Sparkling water, blood-orange juice and a sprig of rosemary.
